AltSelect.name: Active
AltSelect.label: Active
AltSelect.help: Turn AltSelect on or off. When on, dragging a selected operator away while the modifier is held leaves a Select OP wired to the original in its place instead of moving it. Off leaves the component installed but idle.

AltSelect.name: Openauthor
AltSelect.label: Link
AltSelect.help: Open the author's page in your browser.

AutoCombine.name: Active
AutoCombine.label: Active
AutoCombine.help: Turn AutoCombine on or off. When on, dropping a generator TOP (noise, circle, rectangle...) with the modifier held applies the defaults below to it. Off leaves the component installed but idle.

AutoCombine.name: Combineinput
AutoCombine.label: Combine with Input
AutoCombine.help: The Combine with Input mode written onto a generator TOP dropped this way -- how it merges with the TOP it landed on.

AutoCombine.name: Operand
AutoCombine.label: Operation
AutoCombine.help: The Operation written onto the dropped TOP: the maths used to combine it with its input.

AutoCombine.name: Rgb
AutoCombine.label: RGB
AutoCombine.help: The RGB mode written onto generator TOPs that have one (the Noise TOP): whether the noise replaces, multiplies, adds to or subtracts from the input.

AutoCombine.name: Format
AutoCombine.label: Pixel Format
AutoCombine.help: The Pixel Format written onto the dropped TOP. 'Use Input' leaves TouchDesigner's own default alone.

AutoCombine.name: Keys
AutoCombine.label: Keys
AutoCombine.help: The modifier keys held to trigger this gesture, space-separated (TouchDesigner key names). The default is an expression that picks the right keys per platform -- typing a plain value over it pins the tool to one OS.

AutoCombine.name: Openauthor
AutoCombine.label: Link
AutoCombine.help: Open the author's page in your browser.

AutoRes.name: Active
AutoRes.label: Active
AutoRes.help: Turn AutoRes on or off. When on, dropping a generator TOP with the modifier held sets its Output Resolution to follow the project instead of the 1280x720 default. Off leaves the component installed but idle.

AutoRes.name: Resolution
AutoRes.label: Resolution
AutoRes.help: The fallback resolution written into the dropped TOP's Custom Resolution. It is only reached when the network has no parent.Project shortcut to follow -- with one, the TOP tracks that instead.

AutoRes.name: Rgb
AutoRes.label: RGB
AutoRes.help: The RGB mode written onto generator TOPs that have one (the Noise TOP).

AutoRes.name: Format
AutoRes.label: Pixel Format
AutoRes.help: The Pixel Format written onto the dropped TOP. 'Use Input' leaves TouchDesigner's own default alone.

AutoRes.name: Keys
AutoRes.label: Keys
AutoRes.help: The modifier keys held to trigger this gesture, space-separated (TouchDesigner key names). The default is an expression that picks the right keys per platform -- typing a plain value over it pins the tool to one OS.

AutoRes.name: Openauthor
AutoRes.label: Link
AutoRes.help: Open the author's page in your browser.

BorderlessTD.name: Shortcutmakeborderless
BorderlessTD.label: Shortcut
BorderlessTD.help: Key that shows and hides the window's title bar. Windows only.

BorderlessTD.name: Borderless
BorderlessTD.label: Borderless State
BorderlessTD.help: Whether the title bar is hidden right now. Toggling this is the same as pressing the shortcut.

BorderlessTD.name: Shiftesc
BorderlessTD.label: Use Shift-Esc to undo
BorderlessTD.help: Let Shift+Esc put the title bar back. Worth having while you get used to a borderless window; TouchDesigner has no window controls without one.

BorderlessTD.name: Showprojectname
BorderlessTD.label: Show Project Name
BorderlessTD.help: Show the project file's name in the menu bar. Handy once the title bar -- which normally carries it -- is hidden.

BorderlessTD.name: Hidemenubuttons
BorderlessTD.label: Hide Menu Buttons
BorderlessTD.help: Remove the Wiki, Forum and Tutorials links from the main menu bar.

BorderlessTD.name: Onstart
BorderlessTD.label: On Start
BorderlessTD.help: Go borderless as soon as the project opens, rather than waiting for the shortcut.

BorderlessTD.name: Fixfullscreenonstart
BorderlessTD.label: Fix Fullscreen On Start
BorderlessTD.help: Re-assert full screen shortly after the project opens. On by default because TouchDesigner does not reliably start full screen on its own.

BorderlessTD.name: Fullscreen
BorderlessTD.label: Force Full Screen (always)
BorderlessTD.help: Keep the window full screen whenever it is borderless. Turn it off to run TouchDesigner borderless inside a window zone instead of over the whole display.

BorderlessTD.name: Enable
BorderlessTD.label: Enable
BorderlessTD.help: Turn the borderless-window feature on. Off leaves TouchDesigner's window exactly as the OS drew it and the shortcut does nothing.

BorderlessTD.name: Shortcut
BorderlessTD.label: Shortcut
BorderlessTD.help: Key that shows and hides TouchDesigner's timeline.

BorderlessTD.name: Enabletimeline
BorderlessTD.label: Enable
BorderlessTD.help: Turn the timeline-hiding feature on. Off leaves the timeline alone and the shortcut does nothing.

BorderlessTD.name: Statetimeline
BorderlessTD.label: Hide Timeline
BorderlessTD.help: Whether the timeline is hidden right now. Toggling this is the same as pressing the shortcut.

BorderlessTD.name: Stateonstartuptimeline
BorderlessTD.label: State on Startup
BorderlessTD.help: Whether the timeline starts hidden when the project opens.

BorderlessTD.name: Pauseindicator
BorderlessTD.label: Pause Indicator
BorderlessTD.help: Which TouchDesigner UI colour element gets recoloured while playback is paused -- the substitute for the timeline's own pause cue once the timeline is hidden.

BorderlessTD.name: Pausestatecolor
BorderlessTD.label: Pause State Color
BorderlessTD.help: The colour that element takes while playback is paused. Its normal colour is restored on play.

BorderlessTD.name: Openauthor
BorderlessTD.label: Link
BorderlessTD.help: Open the author's page in your browser.

ColorUI.name: Openui
ColorUI.label: Open UI
ColorUI.help: Open the colour editor. It is also the OpColor tab of FNS_Hub, and -- with Expose on the Registry page -- a tab of FNS_Console in the browser.

ColorUI.name: File
ColorUI.label: File (.json)
ColorUI.help: Where Export writes and Import reads. A .json file you can keep in a project, commit, or hand to someone else.

ColorUI.name: Import
ColorUI.label: Import
ColorUI.help: Read colours from the file above and apply them. Imported colours take precedence over the ones saved locally in the component.

ColorUI.name: Export
ColorUI.label: Export
ColorUI.help: Write the current colours to the file above, so they can be shared or version-controlled.

ColorUI.name: Autoload
ColorUI.label: Auto-Load Colors
ColorUI.help: Apply the colours saved in this component when the project opens. Off leaves TouchDesigner's own colours until you open the UI and apply.

ColorUI.name: Groupby
ColorUI.label: Group By
ColorUI.help: How the editor's list is organised: Prefix groups elements by the name they start with, Role groups them by what they are used for.

ColorUI.name: Openauthor
ColorUI.label: Link
ColorUI.help: Open the author's page in your browser.

CustomParTools.name: Refbind
CustomParTools.label: Ref/Bind
CustomParTools.help: How a promoted parameter is linked back to the original. On binds the two (either end can be edited and both follow); off leaves the original in expression mode pointing at the promoted one. Holding the modifier while promoting inverts this for that one action.

CustomParTools.name: Promote
CustomParTools.label: Promote All
CustomParTools.help: Promote every custom parameter on the current page of the referenced COMP to the target COMP at once, linked according to Ref/Bind.

CustomParTools.name: Shortcutcurrentpars
CustomParTools.label: Params: Selected
CustomParTools.help: Hotkey that opens the parameter dialog for the SELECTED operator. Rebindable here or in FNS_HotkeyManager.

CustomParTools.name: Shortcutparentpars
CustomParTools.label: Params: Current COMP
CustomParTools.help: Hotkey that opens the parameter dialog for the COMP whose network is showing.

CustomParTools.name: Shortcutcurrentcomp
CustomParTools.label: Editor: Selected
CustomParTools.help: Hotkey that opens the component editor for the SELECTED operator.

CustomParTools.name: Shortcutparentcomp
CustomParTools.label: Editor: Current COMP
CustomParTools.help: Hotkey that opens the component editor for the COMP whose network is showing.

CustomParTools.name: Openauthor
CustomParTools.label: Link
CustomParTools.help: Open the author's page in your browser.

ExprHotStrings.name: Replaceinline
ExprHotStrings.label: Replace inline
ExprHotStrings.help: Expand an abbreviation anywhere inside an expression, not only when it is the whole expression. Off by default: with it on you can write '#AT * 0.2' and combine abbreviations.

ExprHotStrings.name: Customparpromoteenable
ExprHotStrings.label: CustomPar Promote Enable (#@! for binds, #!~ for refs)
ExprHotStrings.help: Enable the promote abbreviations: '#@!' binds a parameter to the parent and '#!~' references it. On by default.

ExprHotStrings.name: Sync
ExprHotStrings.label: Externalize
ExprHotStrings.help: Externalize the abbreviation table to a file on disk, so it can be edited outside TouchDesigner and version-controlled.

ExprHotStrings.name: Openable
ExprHotStrings.label: #@op Wrap Enable
ExprHotStrings.help: Enable the '#@' abbreviation, which wraps whatever follows in op('...') -- '#@noise1.par.amp' becomes op('noise1').par.amp.

ExprHotStrings.name: Parentshortcutenable
ExprHotStrings.label: #! Parent Shortcut Enable
ExprHotStrings.help: Enable the '#!' abbreviations, which resolve to the closest parent shortcut ('#!' alone, or '#!!' with .par appended).

ExprHotStrings.name: Open
ExprHotStrings.label: Edit Table
ExprHotStrings.help: Open the abbreviation table, where the first column is what you type and the second is what it expands to.

ExprHotStrings.name: Author
ExprHotStrings.label: Author: Function Store @function.str

ExprHotStrings.name: Usage
ExprHotStrings.label: Usage:

ExprHotStrings.name: L1
ExprHotStrings.label: - add new lines to the table

ExprHotStrings.name: L2
ExprHotStrings.label: - start abbreviation (first column) with a unique character

ExprHotStrings.name: L3
ExprHotStrings.label: - it will expand to what you write in the second column

ExprHotStrings.name: L4
ExprHotStrings.label: - type the abbreviation into a parameter's expression box

ExprHotStrings.name: L5
ExprHotStrings.label: - and keep your mouse over it to expand!

ExprHotStrings.name: L6
ExprHotStrings.label: - The contents of the table are saved across your projects if sync is enabled!

ExprHotStrings.name: L7
ExprHotStrings.label: - If enabled #@ will wrap strings after it in op('...') in a smart way

ExprHotStrings.name: L9
ExprHotStrings.label: - If enabled #! will resolve to the closest parent shortcut

ExprHotStrings.name: L10
ExprHotStrings.label: -- and #!! will also add a .par after it

ExprHotStrings.name: L11
ExprHotStrings.label: - If enabled #@! or #!~ will promote parameter as custom par

ExprHotStrings.name: L12
ExprHotStrings.label: -- Can also directly write a custom name such as #@!Myfloat

ExprHotStrings.name: L8
ExprHotStrings.label: - The definitions can be synced across projects if Externalized is enabled

ExprHotStrings.name: Openauthor
ExprHotStrings.label: Link
ExprHotStrings.help: Open the author's page in your browser.

FNS_Autosave.name: Active
FNS_Autosave.label: Active
FNS_Autosave.help: Save the project every Interval minutes. A save stalls the frame while the .toe is written.

FNS_Autosave.name: Interval
FNS_Autosave.label: Interval (min)
FNS_Autosave.help: Minutes between automatic saves. Changing it restarts the countdown.

FNS_Autosave.name: Mode
FNS_Autosave.label: Save Mode
FNS_Autosave.help: TD Save calls project.save(), so it follows TouchDesigner's own Increment Filename / Copy to Backup Folder preferences. Overwrite saves onto the .toe already open and never increments.

FNS_Autosave.name: Onlymodified
FNS_Autosave.label: Only If Modified
FNS_Autosave.help: Skip a scheduled save when no operator has changed since the last one (project.modified is empty).

FNS_Autosave.name: Skipperform
FNS_Autosave.label: Skip In Perform Mode
FNS_Autosave.help: Skip scheduled saves while the project is in Perform Mode. Save Now still works.

FNS_Autosave.name: Status
FNS_Autosave.label: Status
FNS_Autosave.help: When the last save landed, or why the last scheduled one was skipped.

FNS_Autosave.name: Lastsave
FNS_Autosave.label: Last Save
FNS_Autosave.help: Time and filename of the last save this component made.

FNS_Autosave.name: Savenow
FNS_Autosave.label: Save Now
FNS_Autosave.help: Save immediately using the mode above, ignoring the skip toggles.

FNS_Collect.name: Collectui
FNS_Collect.label: Open UI
FNS_Collect.help: Open the collect panel (scan list, per-file selection, collect) in a floating viewer.

FNS_Collect.name: Collectscan
FNS_Collect.label: Scan External Files
FNS_Collect.help: Dry-run of Collect All & Save: scans every file parameter for references outside the project folder and reports the count and total size in Collect Status (details returned to callers). Nothing is copied or rewritten.

FNS_Collect.name: Collectsave
FNS_Collect.label: Collect All & Save
FNS_Collect.help: Copies every external audio/movie/geometry/image file reference into {project}/collected/<category>/, rewrites those parameters to project-relative paths, then saves the .toe. Originals are never moved or deleted; expression-driven parameters are left untouched. Progress appears in Collect Status.

FNS_Collect.name: Collectexpr
FNS_Collect.label: Freeze Expression Refs
FNS_Collect.help: Freeze expressions on collected file references. Off by default: an expression that happens to evaluate to a path is live wiring, and resolving it would detach that rather than bake a value.

FNS_Collect.name: Collectstatus
FNS_Collect.label: Collect Status
FNS_Collect.help: Live progress / result of the most recent scan or collect run.

FNS_CommandPalette.name: Hotkey
FNS_CommandPalette.label: Hotkey
FNS_CommandPalette.help: Keyboard shortcut that opens the palette. Space-separated combos, parts joined with a dot, e.g. ctrl.shift.p. Rebind it from FNS_HotkeyManager.

FNS_CommandPalette.name: Favouritekeys
FNS_CommandPalette.label: Favourite keys
FNS_CommandPalette.help: JSON list of command identities (tool#id) starred with Ctrl+D in the palette. Persisted by the config host.

FNS_CommandPalette.name: Queryhistory
FNS_CommandPalette.label: Query history
FNS_CommandPalette.help: JSON list of executed palette queries, oldest first, recalled with Alt+Up / Alt+Down. Persisted by the config host.

FNS_CommandPalette.name: Visibilityoverrides
FNS_CommandPalette.label: Visibility overrides
FNS_CommandPalette.help: JSON dict of command identity (tool#id) -> true (hidden) or false (shown), set from the Commands tab in FNS_Hub. Your choice beats the tool default in both directions. Persisted by the config host.

FNS_CommandPalette.name: Presets
FNS_CommandPalette.label: Presets
FNS_CommandPalette.help: JSON list of presets: a command identity (tool#id) with arguments baked in, under a name of your own, saved with Alt+S in the palette. Persisted by the config host.

FNS_CommandRegistry.name: Rescan
FNS_CommandRegistry.label: Rescan Tools
FNS_CommandRegistry.help: Re-collect commands from COMPs tagged 'fnscommands' that promote FnsCommands(). Runs automatically on init; pulse after dropping a tool in by hand.

FNS_CommandRegistry.name: Status
FNS_CommandRegistry.label: Status
FNS_CommandRegistry.help: Read-only summary of the current registry: command and tool counts plus the change revision.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Comp
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Tool COMP
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Tool COMP whose settings are persisted. Defaults to the parent component (the host lives inside the tool it publishes).

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Canonicalname
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Canonical Name
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Unique name for this tool's section in the config file.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Callback
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Callback DAT
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Optional config_callbacks DAT for state beyond parameters (onConfigSave/onConfigLoad).

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Createcallbacks
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Create Callbacks
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Spawn a 'config_callbacks' DAT into this tool from the registry's template and wire this host's Callback parameter to it. Safe to pulse again -- an existing DAT is adopted, never overwritten.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Autoregister
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Auto-register
FNS_ConfigHost.help: When on, keep this tool published into the global config registry while this component exists.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Register
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Register
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Publish once into the global config registry, even if Auto-register is off.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Unregister
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Unregister
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Regstatus
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Registration Status
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Read-only status of this host registration.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Autoload
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Auto-load
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Apply this tool's saved section from the config file once per session, shortly after the tool registers. Turn off for a tool whose settings should stay project-local.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Persistpars
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Persist Parameters
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Snapshot and restore the tool COMP's custom parameters (value, expression, bind + mode). Meta pages (About, Version Ctrl, Info, Callbacks, Common) are always skipped; missing parameters are never created on load.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Excludepars
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Exclude Pars
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Space-separated name patterns (tdu.match) of custom parameters to leave out of persistence, e.g. 'Spoutactive Ndi*'. Use for parameters that must boot at their defaults.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Excludepages
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Exclude Pages
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Space-separated page-name patterns to leave out of persistence entirely.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Helpurl
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Help URL
FNS_ConfigHost.help: The tool's wiki/help page. Informational for config; leave empty to skip.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Promotepars
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Promote Parameters
FNS_ConfigHost.help: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound 'Registry' page. Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Configfile
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Config File
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Override the config file location. Empty = the user palette default (FNStools_ext/config/FNStools_config.json). Evaluated by the /sys global; set it on the FNS_Config master so promotion carries it.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Saveall
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Save All Now
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Snapshot every registered tool into the config file now (forwards to the global).

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Loadall
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Load All Now
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Re-apply every registered tool's saved section now (forwards to the global).

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Comp
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Tool COMP
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Tool COMP whose settings are persisted. Defaults to the parent component (the host lives inside the tool it publishes).

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Canonicalname
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Canonical Name
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Unique name for this tool's section in the config file.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Callback
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Callback DAT
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Optional config_callbacks DAT for state beyond parameters (onConfigSave/onConfigLoad).

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Createcallbacks
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Create Callbacks
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Spawn a 'config_callbacks' DAT into this tool from the registry's template and wire this host's Callback parameter to it. Safe to pulse again -- an existing DAT is adopted, never overwritten.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Autoregister
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Auto-register
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: When on, keep this tool published into the global config registry while this component exists.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Register
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Register
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Publish once into the global config registry, even if Auto-register is off.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Unregister
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Unregister
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Regstatus
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Registration Status
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Read-only status of this host registration.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Autoload
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Auto-load
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Apply this tool's saved section from the config file once per session, shortly after the tool registers. Turn off for a tool whose settings should stay project-local.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Persistpars
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Persist Parameters
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Snapshot and restore the tool COMP's custom parameters (value, expression, bind + mode). Meta pages (About, Version Ctrl, Info, Callbacks, Common) are always skipped; missing parameters are never created on load.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Excludepars
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Exclude Pars
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Space-separated name patterns (tdu.match) of custom parameters to leave out of persistence, e.g. 'Spoutactive Ndi*'. Use for parameters that must boot at their defaults.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Excludepages
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Exclude Pages
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Space-separated page-name patterns to leave out of persistence entirely.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Helpurl
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Help URL
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: The tool's wiki/help page. Informational for config; leave empty to skip.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Promotepars
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Promote Parameters
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound 'Registry' page. Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Presaveheal
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Pre-Save Heal
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Configscope
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Config Scope
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Bound to the toolkit root's Config Scope (op.FNS, FNSTools page) -- edit either; the root par is the record. Where FNSTools' persisted settings and bar layouts live. Global: one JSON in the user palette, shared by every project on this machine (last save wins across projects). Project: the roaming file is never read nor written -- everything lives in this project's .toe and travels with it. Switching back to Global: the next save overwrites the shared layout with this project's state.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Configfile
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Config File
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Override the config file location. Empty = the user palette default (FNStools_ext/config/FNStools_config.json). Evaluated by the /sys global; set it on the FNS_Config master so promotion carries it.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Saveall
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Save All Now
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Snapshot every registered tool into the config file now (forwards to the global).

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Loadall
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Load All Now
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Re-apply every registered tool's saved section now (forwards to the global).

FNS_Console.name: Comp
FNS_Console.label: Tool COMP
FNS_Console.help: The tool that contributes this tab. Defaults to the parent component (the host lives inside the tool it publishes).

FNS_Console.name: Canonicalname
FNS_Console.label: Canonical Name
FNS_Console.help: Unique, URL-safe name of the tab (letters, digits, _ -). It is the path: /t/<name>/. Leave empty to use the tool COMP name.

FNS_Console.name: Tabpage
FNS_Console.label: Tab Page
FNS_Console.help: Text DAT holding the tab's HTML. Served verbatim in the console under /t/<name>/ -- inline its CSS and JS; relative fetches resolve under that path.

FNS_Console.name: Tabapi
FNS_Console.label: Tab API
FNS_Console.help: Optional Python DAT defining onConsoleRequest(action, method, body) -> JSON-able. Answers /t/<name>/api/<action>; body is the parsed JSON of a POST, else None.

FNS_Console.name: Localbrowser
FNS_Console.label: Local Browser
FNS_Console.help: Optional: the tool's own web browser panel (a palette webBrowser COMP) rendering the same page. While this tab is exposed the console serves the page, so the console switches that browser's Active off -- a renderer nobody looks at -- and back on when the exposure ends.

FNS_Console.name: Autoregister
FNS_Console.label: Expose to Console
FNS_Console.help: Publish this tab into the console while the component exists. Off = the tool runs only its own local interface and contributes nothing.

FNS_Console.name: Register
FNS_Console.label: Register
FNS_Console.help: Publish once into the console, even if Expose is off.

FNS_Console.name: Unregister
FNS_Console.label: Unregister
FNS_Console.help: Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

FNS_Console.name: Regstatus
FNS_Console.label: Registration Status
FNS_Console.help: Read-only status of this host registration.

FNS_Console.name: Displayed
FNS_Console.label: Shown in Console
FNS_Console.help: Show this tab on the console's tab bar. Off keeps the tab registered but hidden -- it stays listed in the console's tab manager, which writes its choice back here.

FNS_Console.name: Tablabel
FNS_Console.label: Tab Label
FNS_Console.help: What the console's tab bar shows. Empty = the canonical name.

FNS_Console.name: Taborder
FNS_Console.label: Tab Order
FNS_Console.help: Position in the tab bar. Built-ins sit at 0 (Settings) and 10 (Install & remove); contributions default to 50 and sort by this, then by label.

FNS_Console.name: Helpurl
FNS_Console.label: Help URL
FNS_Console.help: The tool's wiki/help page. Informational; leave empty to skip.

FNS_Console.name: Promotepars
FNS_Console.label: Promote Parameters
FNS_Console.help: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound Registry page. Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.

FNS_Console.name: Presaveheal
FNS_Console.label: Pre-Save Heal
FNS_Console.help: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.

FNS_Console.name: Open
FNS_Console.label: Open Console
FNS_Console.help: Serve the console (on the first free port of 36710-36759) and show it -- in the toolkit root's webBrowser panel when there is one, else your system browser.

FNS_HotkeyManager.name: Active
FNS_HotkeyManager.label: Active
FNS_HotkeyManager.help: Turn hotkey management on or off. Off leaves every binding as it is but stops the manager applying, saving or restoring them.

FNS_HotkeyManager.name: Savehotkeys
FNS_HotkeyManager.label: Save Hotkeys
FNS_HotkeyManager.help: Write the declared bindings to your user palette now, so they survive project files and updates. Toolkit hotkeys are always declared; anything else has to be tagged FNS_hotkeys or ticked in the lister's Persist column.

FNS_HotkeyManager.name: Loadhotkeys
FNS_HotkeyManager.label: Load Hotkeys
FNS_HotkeyManager.help: Re-apply the saved bindings from your user palette over what is bound right now.

FNS_HotkeyManager.name: Loaddefault
FNS_HotkeyManager.label: Load Default
FNS_HotkeyManager.help: Put every discovered binding back to the default its own parameter declares, discarding your saved bindings for this session.

FNS_HotkeyManager.name: Forcedefault
FNS_HotkeyManager.label: Force Default
FNS_HotkeyManager.help: Ignore saved bindings entirely and use each parameter's declared default on every load. Use it to get a machine back to a known state; leave it off to keep your own bindings.

FNS_HotkeyManager.name: Excluderoots
FNS_HotkeyManager.label: Excluded Roots
FNS_HotkeyManager.help: Space-separated names of top-level components to SKIP during project-wide hotkey discovery. TD's own ui/sys/local are excluded by default; add other roots here to silence them.

FNS_HotkeyManager.name: Openui
FNS_HotkeyManager.label: Open Hotkey UI
FNS_HotkeyManager.help: Open the hotkey configurator panel: every discovered binding grouped by tool, click a Hotkey cell to rebind via key capture, right-click to reset to default. Conflicts are flagged in the Status column.

FNS_Hub.name: Open
FNS_Hub.label: Open Hub
FNS_Hub.help: Open the FNS Hub window -- the toolkit's one-stop manager: every registry's configurator, the console, and any tab a tool contributes.

FNS_Hub.name: Tabbar
FNS_Hub.label: Tab Bar
FNS_Hub.help: How the hub's tab bar lays out. Rows: fixed-width tabs that wrap into as many rows as needed. Strip: TouchDesigner's folder-tabs widget -- one row with scroll arrows and a dropdown, and drag-to-reorder. Neither has close buttons: hide a tab from its tool's Registry page, bring it back from the right-click menu.

FNS_Hub.name: Activetab
FNS_Hub.label: Active Tab
FNS_Hub.help: Canonical name of the tab currently shown. Written by the tab bar; roams with the config registry so the hub reopens where you left it.

FNS_Hub.name: Tabuserorder
FNS_Hub.label: Tab User Order
FNS_Hub.help: Space-separated canonical names in the order you dragged the tabs into. Tabs not listed follow in their registered order. Roams with the config registry.

FNS_Hub.name: Refreshtabs
FNS_Hub.label: Refresh Tabs
FNS_Hub.help: Re-read the hub registry and rebuild the tab bar. Normally automatic; use after a manual edit inside the tabs container.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Comp
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Tool COMP
FNS_HubRegistry.help: The tool that contributes this tab. Defaults to the parent component (the host lives inside the tool it publishes).

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Canonicalname
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Canonical Name
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Unique name of the tab (letters, digits, _ -). It names the hub's mirror (hubtab_<name>). Leave empty to use the tool COMP name.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Tabcontent
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Tab Content
FNS_HubRegistry.help: What the tab shows. Empty = the tool COMP itself (it must be a panel). A panel COMP anywhere inside the tool is mirrored into the hub; a DAT/CHOP/TOP/SOP/POP is shown through an OP Viewer. Ignored when Tab Parameters is set.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Tabparams
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Tab Parameters
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Show a parameter view of the tool COMP instead of a panel: the page scope to display (e.g. 'Settings', or * for every page). Empty = not a parameter tab.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Autoregister
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Show in Hub
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Publish this tab into FNS_Hub while the component exists. Off = the tool shows nothing in the hub and its panel stays wherever it lives.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Register
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Register
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Publish once into the hub, even if Show in Hub is off.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Unregister
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Unregister
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Regstatus
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Registration Status
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Read-only status of this host registration.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Displayed
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Shown in Hub
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Show this tab on the hub's tab bar. Off keeps the tab registered but hidden -- the hub's tab manager can show it again.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Tablabel
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Tab Label
FNS_HubRegistry.help: What the hub's tab bar shows. Empty = the canonical name.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Taborder
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Tab Order
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Position in the hub's tab bar; the surface configurators sit at 10/20/30, the console viewer at 90; contributions default to 50 and sort by label within an order.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Helpurl
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Help URL
FNS_HubRegistry.help: The tool's wiki/help page; the hub offers it on the tab. Leave empty to skip.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Promotepars
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Promote Parameters
FNS_HubRegistry.help: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound Registry page. Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Presaveheal
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Pre-Save Heal
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Open
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Open Hub
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Open FNS_Hub (the toolkit's one-stop manager window) on this host's tab.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Comp
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Widget COMP
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: Panel COMP published as the toolbar widget. Defaults to the parent component.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Canonicalname
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Canonical Name
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: Unique name for this widget in the global toolbar registry.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Callback
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Callback DAT
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: Optional DAT with toolbar callbacks for this widget.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Createcallbacks
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Create Callbacks
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: Spawn a 'mainmenu_callbacks' DAT into the tool (from the registry's template) and point the Callback parameter at it. Idempotent: an existing DAT is adopted, never overwritten. The hooks are optional lifecycle notifications -- onRegistered, onUnregistered, onDisplayChanged, onSideChanged.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Autoregister
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Auto-register
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: When on, keep this widget published into the global toolbar registry while this component exists.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Register
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Register
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: Publish once into the global toolbar registry, even if Auto-register is off.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Unregister
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Unregister
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Regstatus
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Registration Status
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: Read-only status of this host registration.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Menuorder
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Menu Bar Order
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: Preferred order among registered widgets, managed by the global registry. -1 = no preference (append at the end).

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Align
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Menu Bar Side
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: Which side of the pane bar's path area this item docks to. Left sits after TD's own left-hand icons; right sits between the path area and TD's right-hand icons.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Anchor
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Anchor After
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: Pin this entry into the gap directly AFTER a named stock menu-bar item (e.g. 'tutorials'), overriding the left/right side band. Resolved live each sync: a vanished anchor falls back to the side band and heals if the item returns. Empty = normal side placement.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Displayed
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Displayed
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: Default visibility of the widget in the toolbar (managed by the global registry).

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Barwidth
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Bar Width
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: Width of this widget in the toolbar. 0 = auto (follow the widget). Persisted here; the registry writes manager edits back.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Helpurl
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Help URL
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: The tool's wiki/help page opened from the Configurator (right-click the Name cell). Leave empty to auto-discover from a docsHelper COMP (its Url par) inside the registered panel or its parent.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Promotepars
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Promote Parameters
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound 'Registry' page. Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Presaveheal
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Pre-Save Heal
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.

FNS_MediaBrowser.name: Mediaui
FNS_MediaBrowser.label: Open Browser
FNS_MediaBrowser.help: Open the media browser panel (reference list + preview) in a floating viewer.

FNS_MediaBrowser.name: Mediascan
FNS_MediaBrowser.label: Rescan Media
FNS_MediaBrowser.help: Re-walk the project for media file references (movie / image / audio / geometry) and rebuild the browser list. Nothing is changed on disk or in the network.

FNS_MediaBrowser.name: Mediamissing
FNS_MediaBrowser.label: Missing Only
FNS_MediaBrowser.help: When on, the browser lists only references whose file is missing on disk - the broken ones you actually need to repoint.

FNS_MediaBrowser.name: Mediastatus
FNS_MediaBrowser.label: Media Status
FNS_MediaBrowser.help: Live readout of the last scan, hover, or replacement.

FNS_Navbar.name: Createpulse
FNS_Navbar.label: Install
FNS_Navbar.help: Install the navbar into TouchDesigner's pane bars now. It also installs on project start; this is the manual route after a change, or if the automatic install was skipped.

FNS_Navbar.name: Openauthor
FNS_Navbar.label: Link
FNS_Navbar.help: Open the author's page in your browser.

FNS_NavbarRegistry.help: Read-only status of this host registration.

FNS_NavbarRegistry.name: Menuorder
FNS_NavbarRegistry.label: Navbar Order
FNS_NavbarRegistry.help: Preferred order among registered widgets, managed by the global registry. -1 = no preference (append at the end).

FNS_NavbarRegistry.name: Align
FNS_NavbarRegistry.label: Navbar Side
FNS_NavbarRegistry.help: Which side of the pane bar's path area this item docks to. Left sits after TD's own left-hand icons; right sits between the path area and TD's right-hand icons.

FNS_NavbarRegistry.name: Kind
FNS_NavbarRegistry.label: Item Kind
FNS_NavbarRegistry.help: What the registered COMP is. Widget: a panel placed in the bar's left/right flow. Overlay: an out-of-flow panel (e.g. a click-through layer over the path cells) -- shown but never re-ordered. Logic: a non-panel COMP that just needs a running copy inside every pane bar.

FNS_NavbarRegistry.name: Displayed

FNS_NavbarRegistry.help: Default visibility of the widget in the toolbar (managed by the global registry).

FNS_NavbarRegistry.name: Barwidth

FNS_NavbarRegistry.help: Width of this widget in the toolbar. 0 = auto (follow the widget). Persisted here; the registry writes manager edits back.

FNS_NavbarRegistry.name: Helpurl

FNS_OpMenu.name: Iofilteractive
FNS_OpMenu.label: IO Filter Active
FNS_OpMenu.help: Add Greg Hermanovic's IO filter buttons to the top right of the OP Create dialog: IO shows only operators that talk to something outside TouchDesigner, -IO hides them, All is the default.

FNS_OpMenu.name: Openauthor
FNS_OpMenu.label: Link
FNS_OpMenu.help: Open the author's page in your browser.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Comp
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Widget COMP
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Panel COMP published as the toolbar widget. Defaults to the parent component.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Canonicalname
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Canonical Name
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Unique name for this widget in the global toolbar registry.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Callback
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Callback DAT
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Optional DAT with toolbar callbacks for this widget.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Createcallbacks
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Create Callbacks
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Spawn an 'opmenu_callbacks' DAT into this tool from the registry's template and wire this host's Callback parameter to it. Safe to pulse again -- an existing DAT is adopted, never overwritten.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Panel
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Panel
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: A Panel COMP to inject into /ui/dialogs/menu_op. The zero-code way to contribute a panel -- no callbacks DAT needed. Combined with anything onPanels() returns, not overridden by it.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Panelanchor
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Panel Anchor
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Name of a panel inside /ui/dialogs/menu_op whose output the injected panel's input is wired to. Without it the panel drops out of the dialog's layout flow. Default: searchpanel.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Autoregister
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Auto-register
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: When on, keep this widget published into the global toolbar registry while this component exists.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Register
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Register
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Publish once into the global toolbar registry, even if Auto-register is off.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Unregister
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Unregister
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Regstatus

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Read-only status of this host registration.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Menuorder

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Displayed

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Helpurl
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Help URL

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Promotepars
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Promote Parameters

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Presaveheal

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Comp
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Tool COMP
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: The tool that contributes this tab. Defaults to the parent component (the host lives inside the tool it publishes).

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Canonicalname
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Canonical Name
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Unique name of the tab (letters, digits, _ -). Leave empty to use the tool COMP name. "palette" is TD's own tab and cannot be taken.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Panel
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Tab Panel
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: The panel COMP shown when this tab is selected. Shown in place through a Select COMP, never copied, and sized to the tab slot by the registry (its w/h become slot expressions while registered). Defaults to the tool itself.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Callback
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Callbacks DAT
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Optional Python DAT. onPaletteTab(canonical, previous) fires on every tab change so the tool can react (e.g. route a shared panel). Raise-contained.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Autoregister
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Expose in Palette
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Publish this tab into TouchDesigner's Palette Browser while the component exists. Off = the tool contributes nothing.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Register
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Register
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Publish once into the Palette Browser, even if Expose is off.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Unregister
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Unregister
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Regstatus
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Registration Status
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Read-only status of this host registration.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Displayed
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Shown in Palette
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Show this tab on the Palette Browser's tab strip. Off keeps it registered but hidden; the registry writes its choice back here so it persists with the tool.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Tablabel
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Tab Label
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: What the tab strip shows. Empty = the canonical name.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Taborder
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Tab Order
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Position on the strip after TD's own Palette tab (always first). Contributions default to 50 and sort by this, then by label.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Helpurl
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Help URL
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: The tool's wiki/help page. Informational; leave empty to skip.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Promotepars
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Promote Parameters

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Presaveheal

FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Tab
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Extra Tabs
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Additional tabs published by this one host. The Registration pars above define the FIRST tab; each block here adds one more, so a tool can put several tabs on the strip (optionally over the same panel) without stamping a second host.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Tab0name
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Canonical Name
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Unique name of this extra tab (letters, digits, _ -). Required; the block is skipped while it is empty. "palette" is TD's own tab and cannot be taken.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Tab0source

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Tab0label

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Tab0order
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Tab Order

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Tab0shown
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Shown in Palette
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Show this tab on the strip. Off keeps it registered but hidden.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Comp
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: COMP
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: COMP to register as the pane owner. Defaults to parent (..). PANEL requires a Panel COMP (isPanel); other pane types accept any COMP.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Canonicalname
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Canonical Name
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Name shown in the panebar menu. Leave empty to use the host COMP name.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Callback
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Callback
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Optional Text DAT with onPaneRecall(ctx). Invoked after built-in recall actions. Use Create Callback for a skeleton.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Createcallbacks
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Create Callback
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Create a callbacks Text DAT with a default onPaneRecall(ctx) skeleton and assign it to Callback. Will not overwrite non-empty existing callbacks text.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Autoregister
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Auto-register
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: When on, register the host COMP immediately and keep recall flags / callback in sync when settings change. When off, use Register or Python RegisterPanel.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Register
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Register
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Register the host COMP now (even if Auto-register is off). Validates COMP type against Pane Type.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Unregister
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Unregister
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Regstatus
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Status
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Read-only status of host auto-registration (Idle, Registered, Skipped under /sys or /ui, Error).

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Menuorder
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Menu Order
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Preferred order among registered panebar entries. -1 = no preference (append, default). 0 = first among custom entries, 1 = second, and so on. Built-in rows are not moved.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Panetype
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Pane Type
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Pane type applied when this entry is selected in the panebar. PANEL is typical for containerCOMP UIs.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Setowner
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Set Owner
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: When on, set the pane owner to the registered COMP when this entry is selected.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Changetype
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Change Type
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: When on, change the pane to the selected Pane Type. changeType returns a new Pane object; Maximize/Float/Callback run after.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Maximize
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Maximize
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: When on, maximize the pane after recall (pane.maximize = True).

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Tearaway
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Tear Away
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: When on, tear the pane into a floating window after recall (pane.tearAway()).

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Float
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Float
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Open the registered COMP in a floating window. PANEL/Geometry/TOP/CHOP -> openViewer(); PARAMETERS -> openParameters(); Network Editor and other tool types -> showInPane Floating.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Openparameters
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Open Parameters
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: When on, open a floating parameter dialog for the registered COMP (op.openParameters()). Available for any pane type.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Promotepars
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Promote Parameters
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound 'Registry' page. Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Presaveheal
